outline: 本課程在於教導學生認識工業上最主要的均相催化反應，介紹過渡金屬催化於有機合成及高分子合成之應用並討論其反應機構。
schedule:
第一週
授課大綱,進度,考試規定及評分標準說明
第二週
和平紀念日
第三週
Quantum of Numbers of Multielectron Atoms
第四週
Electron Spectra of Coordination Compounds
第五週
Octahedral Substitution Reaction
第六週
Substitution Reaction of Square-Planar Complexes
第七週
Oxidation-Reduction Reactions
第八週
Reaction of Coordinated Ligands
第九週
期中考
第十週
The 18-Electron Rule Ligands in Organometallic Chemistry
第十一週
Bonding Between Metal Atoms and Organic pai System
第十二週
Complexes Containing M-C, M=C and MC Bonds
第十三週
Spectra Analysis and Characterization of Organometallic Complexes
第十四週
Organometallic Reaction and Catalysis: Reaction Involving Gain or Loss of Ligands
第十五週
Organometallic Reaction and Catalysis: Reaction Involving Modification of Ligands
第十六週
Organometallic Reaction and Catalysis: Organometallic Catalysis
第十七週
Organometallic Reaction and Catalysis: Heterogeneous Catalysis
第十八週
期末考試
assessment:
期中考試: 50%
期末考試: 50%
